reviews.summary: Whole-file examination: handle registration, native capability admission, configuration publication, acquisition, presentation and release.
findings: configure_surface destroys the previous swapchain and publishes configured/dimensions before fallible capability and swapchain creation; failed replacement leaves partially published state.
unconfigure_surface/release_surface destroy swapchain resources without establishing completion of acquired/render/present work; ownership must survive unknown completion.
resolvedFindings: get_surface_capabilities now rejects handles without a native surface; the regression verifies missing handles, unbacked handles and duplicate creation.
reviews.nextAction: Make surface replacement transactional with native completion ownership, then exercise failure/retry on a presentation-capable host.

reviews.summary: Whole-file examination: sampler translation, generation allocation, replacement, native creation and destruction.
findings: create_sampler always disables anisotropy even when max_anisotropy requests it; unsupported requests must fail or enable the qualified feature.
Filter/address/compare helpers silently coerce unknown values; translation duplicates src/native/vulkan/vulkan_sampler_native.zig.
destroy_sampler removes and destroys without waiting or retaining references used by pending commands; replacement only checks one deferred-work flag.
reviews.nextAction: Unify validated sampler translation at its existing owner and connect destruction/replacement to completed command references.

reviews.summary: Whole-file examination: path resolution, sibling lookup, WGSL translation, SPIR-V decoding and cache allocation/release.
findings: kernel_spirv_cache is keyed only by the supplied name and has no aggregate retention policy or content revision identity; a name hit can outlive changed input bytes.
words_from_spirv_bytes checks alignment and magic only; full structural/module validation must remain an explicit compiler admission responsibility.
resolvedFindings: Sibling SPIR-V lookup only replaces the filename extension, preserving dotted parent directories.
File reads preserve allocation/I/O failures; WGSL translation preserves OutOfMemory. Exhaustive allocator-failure tests cover source loading and compilation cleanup.
reviews.nextAction: Bind source-cache identity to an immutable input contract and define bounded retention; connect external SPIR-V admission to validated compiler metadata.

reviews.summary: Whole-file examination retains the device-owned registry: exact shader/entrypoint/layout/subgroup equality, owned immutable words, checked references, rollback and final release.
reviews.nextAction: Revalidate on identity or lifetime changes; this file verdict grants no directory or end-to-end completion qualification.

reviews.summary: Whole-file examination: bounded instruction scans for literal local size and workgroup storage.
findings: compute_local_size selects the first LocalSize execution mode without matching the selected entrypoint; vk_pipeline uses it for subgroup selection.
LocalSizeId/specialization and malformed instruction streams return absent/partial facts rather than validated metadata; has_workgroup_storage conflates unknown parsing with absence.
reviews.nextAction: Consume compiler-validated metadata keyed to the selected entrypoint; test multiple entrypoints, specialization and malformed streams without inferring absence from unknown data.

reviews.summary: Whole-file examination: fence ring, wait/drain/deinit, timeline creation/query/wait, feature detection and submission bookkeeping.
findings: FencePool.deinit and TimelineSemaphore.deinit swallow native wait errors before destruction; unknown completion must retain native resources.
wait_for_fence_fast uses a local polling-spin constant while wait budgets/policy remain distributed across upload and runtime owners.
Native device-loss/unknown results retain synchronization obligations here, but caller resource cleanup still needs complete-path review and failure injection.
resolvedFindings: Rejected host/device OOM submissions roll back only the latest fence reservation and do not publish unsubmitted timeline values; earlier obligations and retry are preserved.
Timeline creation failure propagates; value exhaustion fails explicitly. State-transition regressions retain obligations on device loss/unknown status.
reviews.nextAction: Unify completion-owned retirement across runtime/upload/render/texture callers; inject native submit/wait failures before declaring teardown verified.

reviews.summary: Whole-file examination: calibrated normalization shader generation, compilation cache, scratch ownership, query transfer and conversion dispatch.
findings: compiled_shader stores a reserved textual key in the same kernel_spirv_cache used for caller kernel names; no tagged namespace separates internal calibration shader identity from file inputs.
Resolve stores only a resource handle; repeated init and count changes have no local initialized/capacity contract. Make ownership and supported reuse explicit at caller and callee boundaries.
reviews.nextAction: Give calibrated shaders a distinct cache identity and make scratch initialization/capacity invariants explicit with lifecycle tests.

reviews.summary: Whole-file examination: validated buffer-image copy regions, transitions, command texture upload/copy and synchronous submission.
findings: texture_write constructs its own region using bytes-per-pixel and fixed layer/depth values instead of the block-aware buffer_copy_region contract; compressed formats and layered/volume uploads need common admission.
texture_copy accepts native image regions without the complete source/destination footprint checks used by buffer copies.
Synchronous helpers and staging defer cleanup do not retain resources when native completion is unknown.
resolvedFindings: Timeline submission now delegates result-dependent publication to vk_sync rather than advancing an unsubmitted wait target.
reviews.nextAction: Route command texture operations through canonical footprint validation and completion-owned staging retirement; exercise compressed, layered, aliased and failed-wait cases.

reviews.summary: Whole-file examination: raw Vulkan result constants, typed errors and diagnostic names.
findings: map_vk_result collapses allocation failure, device loss and timeout into InvalidState and maps unknown/pool exhaustion to UnsupportedFeature; callers lose original causes and can mistake failure for lack of capability.
resolvedFindings: Named host/device allocation and device-loss results authorize conservative submission bookkeeping without changing public error taxonomy.
reviews.nextAction: Extend canonical typed error propagation and audit capability-fallback consumers before remapping native results.

reviews.summary: Whole-file examination: platform surface constructors, capability enumeration, swapchain selection/creation, semaphores, acquisition and presentation.
findings: create_swapchain publishes native handles before all image/synchronization setup succeeds; failure/retired-old-swapchain ownership is incomplete.
present_image has no render-finished wait semaphore and returns success for VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_DATE_KHR; acquisition/render/present synchronization and failure outcomes need an end-to-end correction.
choose_surface_format silently substitutes native formats, including RGBA8UnormSrgb to UNORM; exact format and tone-mapping admission are not preserved.
desired_maximum_frame_latency is retained in state but does not govern swapchain image count or acquire pacing.
reviews.nextAction: Repair exact surface admission and acquire/render/present ownership together, with native windowed tests and submission-failure retention.

reviews.summary: Whole-file examination retains pure timing aliases/calibration data and checked elapsed-counter conversion.
resolvedFindings: Elapsed subtraction wraps at the reported valid-bit width; invalid periods/widths and unrepresentable nanoseconds fail before conversion.
Tests cover short/full-width wrap, fractional truncation, equal samples, invalid calibration and overflow. Both runtime consumers pass native queue calibration.
reviews.nextAction: Revalidate when calibration or timing semantics change; elapsed conversion cannot disambiguate multiple counter wraps.
